newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya calls regional summit for November 5.
newsitem.headline: Kenya calls regional summit for November 5.

text.p: Kenya will host a summit of seven African countries on November 5, state radio announced on Thursday without saying if the main subject would be the war in eastern Zaire.
The Kenya Broadcasting Corporation said President Daniel arap Moi would meet the leaders of Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, Rwanda, Ethiopia and Cameroon in Nairobi.
It gave no details and presidential officials were unavailable on Thursday night to elaborate.
But the group has met several times in the past months to discuss the crisis in Burundi and imposed sanctions on that country on July 31 as a penalty for a military coup.
Zaire has previously taken part in the Burundi summits and its absence from the list of countries announced on Thursday was unexplained.
Zaire's ragged army is losing ground in the east against ethnic Tutsi rebels. The government in Kinshasa accuses Rwanda of aiding the rebels, a charge which Kigali denies.
